Overview 
 At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.
We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.
At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.
Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery.
‎
 About The Opportunity
 As a Senior Angular Developer, you will play a key role in shaping the user experience of our clinical genomics platform. Working on sophisticated, data-intensive applications, you will help build intuitive interfaces that enable scientists and clinicians to transform complex genomic information into actionable insights.
This opportunity offers a high level of ownership, technical influence, and collaboration within an international engineering environment. You will contribute to architectural decisions, mentor colleagues, and help drive front-end excellence as we continue expanding our engineering presence in Cluj.
 Your Tasks
Developing scalable, high-performance front-end applications using Angular and TypeScript
Designing and implementing intuitive user experiences for complex scientific and analytical workflows
Creating and maintaining reusable components and front-end frameworks to support product scalability
Collaborating closely with product managers, UX designers, back-end engineers, and data specialists
Optimising application performance for large datasets and interactive visualisation tools
Driving front-end architecture, coding standards, testing strategies, and development best practices
Mentoring team members through code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing
 Your Profile
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
8+ years' experience developing modern web applications with Angular and TypeScript
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), front-end architecture, and scalable application design
Experience working with state management solutions such as NgRx, RxJS, Signals, or similar technologies
Very important: Data projects, Charting libraries, Reporting
Knowledge of REST APIs and integration with complex back-end services; GraphQL experience is beneficial
Experience building data-intensive applications, dashboards, visualisation tools, or analytical platforms
Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to contribute effectively within international teams
*Expected presence onsite in the Cluj-Napoca office for 3 days per week.
 Nice To Have
Healthcare, life sciences, biotech, clinical, or scientific software environments
Data visualisation technologies such as D3.js or similar charting frameworks
Angular component libraries and design systems
Modern development tooling including Angular CLI, Vite, or Webpack
Cloud-based environments such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform
Experience in Healthcare, bioinformatics.
Experience with Backend (Java, Spring MVC, Spring Boot)
